meta.parties: Chelliah Pillai v. Devadasan Et Al

rules.statement: A deed registered in a new folio but connected by cross-references to the correct folio is considered duly registered for the purpose of priority over another deed.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view the added first defendant's deed was duly registered so far as the plaintiff is concerned and this view is amply supported by authority. The case of Mudalihamy v. Punchibanda[ 1 5 Ceylon Law Recorder 73.] was very similar to this."
